name: PersonalTrainerSessionPackManager
tagline: Sell, track, freeze and renew personal-training packs – with trainer utilisation and commission built in.
description: A complete personal-training module in one Power Apps code component: session credits and balances, session logging with late-cancel policy, freezes and extensions, expiry and inactivity alerts, a renewal pipeline board, trainer utilisation and commission statements, and an expiry timeline. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Session logging (attended, late cancel, no-show, covering trainer)
Expiring, low-balance and inactive client alerts
Freeze / unfreeze with expiry shift and max-freeze rule
Expiry extension and cancel/refund with reasons
Renewal pipeline with carry-over of unused sessions
Trainer utilisation and commission statement CSV
Bulk export, renewal offers, transfer, extend, cancel
Undo, validation, keyboard and touch support
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
